resources.string: Google is used to check connectivity and ipwho.is to estimate location from IP. VPN checks use the selected VPN network; location lookup without VPN uses the current internet connection. These services see the requests and outgoing IP address. Profiles and settings are encrypted on the device. There are no advertising or analytics SDKs.

In Router, install the FoxHole package on supported OpenWrt or connect the phone to an existing FoxHole installation. Help is available beside the settings. Unpairing disables management; delete the client separately to revoke VPN access.

When enabled in Settings → Background updates, subscriptions refresh about every 12 hours and signed connection data is checked every 24 hours by default. Each check can be disabled in settings. FoxHole DB connection-data updates are installed when you choose. With automatic subscription updates enabled, supported profiles update automatically. Android may delay background checks. In-app updates of the application itself are available only in the GitHub version.
